policy: These destination clarifications amend routing descriptions only. No existing task, rubric, required ownership or evidence contract is rewritten. Original source packs are historical frozen contracts; this file is authoritative for current displayed handoffs. Planned means not yet authored or certified.

textCorrections.limits/convergence/infinite series (M09): Limits/convergence: M09. Infinite geometric/power/Taylor series: M12 S10–S17; broader convergence-test catalogues require M12-A.
textCorrections.epsilon-limit/convergence/infinite-serie: Epsilon limits/convergence: M09. Infinite series: M12 S10–S17; legal interchange and broader tests: planned M12-A.
textCorrections.Infinite geometric series reserved M09: Infinite geometric series: M12-S10, after M09 limits; M09 does not own series.
textCorrections.Optional stopping theorem/martingales un: Planned M49-S: finite-state martingales and bounded optional stopping first; general/unbounded results require M26-P/M28-P and explicit extra hypotheses.
textCorrections.Unbounded geometric waiting laws until M: M26 canonical discrete laws (inherited A12): geometric waiting on {1,2,…}, including P(T>n) and finite mean conditions. M50 owns continuous event-time models.
textCorrections.Infinite-horizon ruin: Planned M49-S-01/-06: nearest-neighbor ruin via finite-barrier recurrences and justified limits; this does not cover arbitrary controlled bankroll processes.
textCorrections.Dynamic-programming or policy optimizati: M59 deterministic DP / M60 MDP policy optimization (planned); neither is a game-existence theorem.
textCorrections.formal expected-utility representation t: Planned M09-U: finite vNM representation and positive affine uniqueness, after M05/M09, with explicit lottery axioms.
textCorrections.general Nash/minimax existence theorems,: General finite Nash/minimax existence: planned M53-G after M09-A/M09-U/M52/M53. Repeated/Bayesian games and auctions/mechanism design are separate future specialisations, not promised by the shared route.
textCorrections.General equilibrium/minimax existence th: Planned M53-G: general finite mixed Nash existence and finite zero-sum minimax, with compactness/fixed-point and LP-duality prerequisites. More general game domains require the separate Kakutani subgate.
textCorrections.Bayesian posterior inference and prior m: Finite hypothesis updating/prediction: M06. Continuous parameter inference/prior modelling: planned M33-B after M26 and M33.
